title: Bug 654493: [29.x] ICM 51000002285173: Fix direct transfer upgrade
summary: The Base Application upgrade of direct transfer orders no longer reads Inventory Setup when no orders need migration. If the setup record is missing, it falls back to Shipment and Receipt. If setup exists, the configured direct transfer posting type is kept.
key_points: Skip Inventory Setup access when no direct transfer orders need migration
Handle missing Inventory Setup by using existing Shipment and Receipt fallback
Preserve configured direct transfer posting types when setup exists
Applied to all localization layers (W1, AT, BE, CH, IT, NL, NO, RU)
Fixes upgrade failures related to direct transfer data migration
quote: skip Inventory Setup access when no direct transfer orders require migration
